Finding cheap universities in UK for international students is usually the first step for anyone trying to keep the cost of studying abroad under control. But the lowest tuition fee is not always the lowest overall cost.

For students planning a 2027 intake, there is another important point. Many universities have not yet published their final 2027/28 international fees. The figures below therefore use the latest published fees available in September 2026 and should be checked again before you pay a deposit.

Last checked: September 2026. These are the latest published figures used for planning. They are not guaranteed 2027/28 fees.

For example, Queen Margaret University's current fee information shows £9,725 for eligible international undergraduate courses, while Wrexham University's published international fees show £11,750 for undergraduate study and £12,500 for MA/MSc programmes.

How we identify low cost universities in UK for international students

“Cheap” needs a clear definition.

A low-tuition university has a particularly low published international fee for a qualifying programme.

A low-cost university may also benefit from lower accommodation, transport and everyday expenses.

The two are not interchangeable.

When comparing universities, look at:

  • exact tuition for your course
  • undergraduate or postgraduate level
  • scholarship or fee reductions
  • accommodation
  • food and transport
  • course-specific expenses
  • deposit and payment requirements
  • total degree length

This approach prevents a common mistake: treating the lowest fee for one course as though it applies to every student at the university.

Cheapest undergraduate universities in UK for international students

Queen Margaret University

Queen Margaret University is one of the most interesting places to start when tuition is the main concern.

For 2026/27, eligible international undergraduate courses include fees of £9,725 per year. The rate does not apply to every subject, and health-related programmes can cost considerably more. Its published undergraduate fee schedule shows the course-level differences.

Best for: selected business, media, education and other eligible undergraduate courses.

Check: exact programme fee, scholarship, course length and accommodation.

Wrexham University

Wrexham University publishes an international undergraduate fee of £11,750 for 2026/27. Current international fees also include £12,500 for MA/MSc programmes and £13,000 for MBA study. Wrexham's international fee information states that the undergraduate international tuition fee remains the same throughout the degree under its current policy.

That makes Wrexham particularly useful for students who want a lower-cost degree with more predictable tuition budgeting.

Best for: business, computing and practical subjects.

Leeds Trinity University

Leeds Trinity lists £12,000 for standard international undergraduate courses in 2026/27. Nursing is higher at £14,500, and the university also has separate arrangements for placement years. Eligible students on certain courses can receive scholarship support. The current international fee details show the different rates.

Best for: business, education, psychology, journalism and media-related subjects.

University of Chester

For 2026/27, the University of Chester lists £14,950 for standard international undergraduate study and £15,500 for postgraduate taught courses. Its MBA is £15,700. The university's fee information also explains its international scholarship arrangements.

Best for: students who want a broad course choice in a smaller city.

University of Cumbria

Many standard international undergraduate courses at the University of Cumbria are currently priced at around £16,000 for 2026/27, although specialist programmes can cost more.

The university's locations can be useful for students who value a smaller-city environment as well as reasonable tuition.

Best for: business, education, environmental subjects and students who prefer regional locations.

Cheapest postgraduate universities in UK for international students

Postgraduate study deserves a separate comparison because a one-year master's can produce a very different overall budget from a three-year undergraduate degree.

York St John University

York St John is particularly worth comparing for affordable master's study. Several 2026/27 international MSc programmes are priced at £11,800, including International Business MSc. Its MBA is currently listed at £12,000.

That makes it one of the stronger options for students specifically searching for lower postgraduate tuition.

Wrexham University

Wrexham's current £12,500 fee for MA/MSc programmes places it comfortably among the lower-priced options for many international postgraduate students.

University of Chester

Chester currently charges £15,500 for postgraduate taught study, with the MBA at £15,700. Eligible students may receive international scholarship support, so the final amount payable can be lower.

Students comparing additional postgraduate routes can explore other lower-cost postgraduate options in the UK.

Teesside's current published international fees are £17,000 for many undergraduate and postgraduate courses, while Sunderland's standard international undergraduate fee is £17,500. Those figures are higher than Wrexham or Leeds Trinity, but regional living costs can still make them worth comparing.

Students who need to weigh affordability against entry requirements can also look at UK universities with comparatively accessible entry routes.

Cheap universities in Scotland for international students

Scotland has some attractive options, but the degree structure needs attention.

Queen Margaret University currently publishes £9,725 for eligible international undergraduate courses in 2026/27, although subject-specific rates can be higher.

The University of the Highlands and Islands lists international undergraduate fees of around £16,820 for several arts, humanities, social sciences and business routes, with higher fees for science and technology.

There is another difference that matters when calculating the real cost. Many Scottish undergraduate degrees take four years rather than three, so an annual tuition fee should never be viewed in isolation.

For students comparing the wider Scottish study landscape, this guide to studying in Scotland can provide additional planning context.

Cheap universities in Wales for international students

Wales is worth considering when you want lower tuition outside the UK's most expensive cities.

Wrexham University currently publishes £11,750 for international undergraduate study and £12,500 for MA/MSc programmes for 2026/27.

The combination of tuition, location and the university's current fee policy makes Wrexham one of the strongest starting points for a budget-focused 2027 shortlist.

Universities in UK with low tuition fees: what is the real cost?

Tuition is only one part of your budget.

A realistic first-year calculation can include:

What to budget for

Accommodation

IHS

Course costs

Equipment, placements or professional expenses

Flights and other journeys

Deposit

Upfront university payment

Students also need to meet the applicable financial requirement. Current GOV.UK guidance uses different maintenance figures for London and locations outside London, making location an important part of any affordability comparison.

Is it cheaper to study outside London?

For many students, yes.

London can offer excellent access to employers, professional networks and industries, but accommodation and everyday spending can significantly increase your annual budget.

A regional university can therefore be more affordable even when its tuition is not the absolute lowest.

For example, saving £2,000 on tuition does not help much if accommodation and transport cost you £250 more every month.

That is why location should be treated as part of the cost calculation, not as an afterthought.

Scholarships for international students in the UK

Scholarships can completely change the comparison.

Leeds Trinity lists a standard international undergraduate fee of £12,000 for 2026/27, while eligible international students on certain courses can receive a scholarship deduction.

Chester also offers international scholarship support, and York St John currently lists a £1,000 scholarship for eligible international undergraduate fee-paying students at its York campus. The availability and eligibility of each award should be checked for the year and course you are applying for.

Wrexham also publishes scholarships and bursaries for international students alongside its fee information.

The useful calculation is therefore:

published tuition → scholarship → actual tuition payable

Can international students study in the UK without IELTS?

Some universities accept alternative English evidence, but there is no universal “no IELTS” rule.

Depending on the university and course, alternatives may include another approved English test, previous education taught in English or another accepted form of evidence.

For the wider admission picture, this guide to studying in the UK without IELTS is useful. Students considering a Medium of Instruction certificate can also review how UK universities may treat MOI evidence.

Can international students work while studying in the UK?

Part-time work can help with living expenses, but it should not be the foundation of a tuition budget.

Plan as though your tuition is already covered. Treat any income from part-time work as additional support.

What changes for students starting in 2027?

2027/28 tuition fees

Many universities have not yet published their final 2027/28 international fees.

When the future price is unavailable, the safest approach is to use the latest confirmed fee for planning and then check the university again before paying a deposit.

This distinction matters because a 2026/27 price is not automatically a 2027/28 price.

How to choose a cheap UK university without making a costly mistake

Start with the course.

Then compare the numbers.

Check the exact tuition fee

A university's lowest advertised fee may apply only to a limited group of courses.

Check the scholarship-adjusted fee

A slightly higher published fee can become cheaper after a realistic scholarship.

Add accommodation

This is where regional universities can make a noticeable difference.

Check the upfront payment

Allow for course-specific expenses

Healthcare, laboratory, engineering and placement courses may have additional costs.

Compare the whole degree

A three-year undergraduate course and a four-year Scottish degree should not be compared using only one year's tuition.

Think about the career outcome

A low fee is poor value if the course does not support your career plans.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest university in the UK for international students?

There is no permanent single cheapest university because fees vary by course and study level. Among the latest published figures, Queen Margaret University has eligible undergraduate courses at £9,725 for 2026/27, while Wrexham publishes £11,750 for international undergraduate study.

What are the best low cost universities in UK for international students?

Queen Margaret University, Wrexham University, Leeds Trinity University, York St John University, University of Chester and University of Cumbria are useful starting points. The right choice depends on your course, budget and location.

Which UK universities have low tuition fees for international students?

Current lower-fee options include Queen Margaret University, Wrexham University, Leeds Trinity University and York St John University for selected programmes. The lowest published fee does not necessarily apply to every course.

What are the cheapest undergraduate universities in UK for international students?

Queen Margaret University, Wrexham University, Leeds Trinity University, University of Chester and University of Cumbria are strong options to compare using current published fees.

Which are the cheapest universities in UK for master's degrees?

York St John University currently lists several international MSc programmes at £11,800, while Wrexham's current international MA/MSc fee is £12,500.

Can I study in the UK for under £10,000 a year?

Are there cheap universities in Scotland for international students?

Yes. Queen Margaret University and the University of the Highlands and Islands are useful options to compare, although the fees and degree structure vary by course.

Are there cheap universities in UK for international students without IELTS?

Is it cheaper to study outside London?

Can international students work while studying?

What should I budget for a 2027 UK application?

Are cheap UK universities worth it?

Yes, when the course fits your career plan, the university is suitable, the city works for your budget and the full cost is manageable. Tuition alone is not enough to judge value.

Final thoughts

There are several cheap universities in UK for international students, but the lowest tuition fee should only be the starting point.

For undergraduate applicants, Queen Margaret University, Wrexham University and Leeds Trinity University are particularly worth comparing on current published figures. For postgraduate students, York St John University and Wrexham University stand out among the lower-cost options.

Then look beyond the headline fee.

That is the figure that tells you whether a university is genuinely affordable.

For students planning a 2027 intake, use the latest published fee as a planning figure, check the university's 2027/28 fee when it becomes available, and confirm the final amount before paying a deposit.

For the wider process of choosing a UK university and planning your application, this guide for international students considering UK study is a useful next step.
